articles.title: Video Game Movies Are Entering a New Era
articles.summary: 2026 game films drew big audiences, and studios are now planning many more adaptations, including Elden Ring, Zelda, and a PUBG series.

articles.title: Godzilla Stars Bring Hollywood Cheers Back to Tokyo
articles.summary: The Godzilla Minus Zero cast recalled nonstop applause and fan chants in Los Angeles at the Tokyo festival, days before the film opens in Japan.

articles.title: Harriet Dart Reaches Her First WTA Singles Final
articles.summary: Harriet Dart beat Sun Xinran in three sets at the Guangzhou Open to reach her first WTA Tour singles final, where she will face Lilli Tagger.
